changes.before: Inflation has been subdued, although the prices of some key commodities have increased recently.
changes.after: Inflation recently picked up somewhat, reflecting higher energy prices.

changes.before: Household spending has continued to advance, but growth in business fixed investment appears to have slowed.
changes.after: Household spending has advanced a bit more quickly, but growth in business fixed investment has slowed.

changes.before: The Committee is concerned that, without further policy accommodation, economic growth might not be strong enough
changes.after: The Committee remains concerned that, without sufficient policy accommodation, economic growth might not be strong enough

changes.before: the Committee agreed today to increase policy accommodation by purchasing additional agency mortgage-backed securities at a pace of $40 billion per month.
changes.after: the Committee will continue purchasing additional agency mortgage-backed securities at a pace of $40 billion per month.

changes.before: preferred to omit the description of the time period over which exceptionally low levels for the federal funds rate are likely to be warranted.
changes.after: disagreed with the description of the time period over which a highly accommodative stance of monetary policy will remain appropriate and exceptionally low levels for the federal funds rate are likely to be warranted.

parsed.rationale: Policy settings and forward guidance are unchanged, with the statement largely continuing the September program; the only notable shift is acknowledging inflation picked up due to energy prices, offset by unchanged medium-term inflation outlook. Mixed descriptive changes in spending and investment leave the overall signal essentially the same.
